actions.label: Zoom
actions.intent: Start the screen magnifier, or stop it when it is running.

actions.label: Screenshot
actions.intent: Open the screenshot and recording menu.

actions.label: Color Picker
actions.intent: Pick a color from the screen and copy it.

actions.label: Speech to Text
actions.intent: Start dictating; the spoken words are typed where the cursor is, with media paused.

actions.label: Voice Command
actions.intent: Listen for one spoken voice command.

actions.label: Stop Voice
actions.intent: End the voice session, a waiting picker and any recording, discarding what was said.

actions.label: Clipboard History
actions.intent: Pick an entry from the clipboard history and copy it back.

actions.label: Delete Clipboard Entry
actions.intent: Pick an entry from the clipboard history and delete it.

actions.label: Jump to Directory
actions.intent: Pick a frequently used directory and open it in the file manager.

actions.label: Emoji Picker
actions.intent: Pick a character and type it into the focused window.

actions.label: Search windows
actions.intent: Open the workspace overview with window search active.

actions.label: Move window in overview
actions.intent: Open the overview carrying the focused window, and follow it to the workspace it is dropped on.

actions.label: Silent move window in overview
actions.intent: Open the overview carrying the focused window, and stay on the current workspace when it is dropped.
